pairs: I will not be silent, and for the sake of Jerusalem,
donec egrediatur ut splendor justus ejus,
I will not rest, until her Just One advances in splendor,
et salvator ejus ut lampas accendatur.
and her Savior is kindled like a lamp.
And the Gentiles will see your Just One,
and all the kings will see your Renowned One.
And you shall be called by a new name,
which the mouth of the Lord will choose.
Et eris corona gloriæ in manu Domini,
And you shall be a crown of glory in the hand of the Lord,
et diadema regni in manu Dei tui.
and a royal diadem in the hand of your God.
You will no longer be called Forsaken.
et terra tua non vocabitur amplius Desolata;
And your land will no longer be called Desolate.
you shall be called My Will within it,
and your land shall be called Inhabited.
For the Lord has been well pleased with you,
and your land will be inhabited.
For the young man will live with the virgin,
et habitabunt in te filii tui;
and your children will live with you.
And the groom will rejoice over the bride,
et gaudebit super te Deus tuus.
and your God will rejoice over you.
I have stationed watchmen all day and all night unceasingly;
tota die et tota nocte in perpetuum non tacebunt.
You who are mindful of the Lord,
and you should not grant silence to him,
donec stabiliat et donec ponat Jerusalem laudem in terra.
until he makes firm and establishes Jerusalem as a praise upon the earth.
Juravit Dominus in dextera sua, et in brachio fortitudinis suæ:
The Lord has sworn with his right hand and with the arm of his strength: “Certainly,
Si dedero triticum tuum ultra cibum inimicis tuis;
I will no longer permit your grain to be the food of your enemies.
et si biberint filii alieni vinum tuum in quo laborasti.
And the sons of foreigners will not drink your wine, for which you have labored.”
For those who gather it will eat it,
and they will praise the Lord.
et qui comportant illud, bibent in atriis sanctis meis.
And those who bring it together will drink it in my holy courts.
Prepare a way for the people!
and lift up a sign for the people!
Ecce Dominus auditum fecit in extremis terræ:
Behold, the Lord has caused it to be heard to the ends of the earth.
Behold, his reward is with him,
